findings: Dangling aria-labelledby when hideHeader={true} — BadgeCollection's <section> always carries aria-labelledby="badge-collection-heading" but the element with that id is inside the conditionally-suppressed header block. On the dashboard this breaks the ARIA reference; screen readers cannot announce the section name. Fix: aria-labelledby={hideHeader ? undefined : 'badge-collection-heading'}.

BadgeMiniWidget refresh does not update badge display — BadgeMiniWidget.handleRefresh calls the refreshAchievements server action but does not re-trigger the useAchievements or useBadgeStatus hooks that supply data to BadgeCollection. The spinner plays but the displayed badges stay stale until full navigation. Fix: expose a refetch from the hooks and call it after refreshAchievements resolves, matching the pattern used on /client/profile and /coach/profile.
